name: fine-volume
description: The volume in even steps down to very quiet, a larger slider with its value, and finer steps with the mouse wheel.

range.label: Range
range.description: How far below full volume 1 on the slider is. The more, the quieter it goes.

step.label: Step
step.description: How far one notch of the mouse wheel over the player bar changes the volume. With Shift held it is 1.
